title: Bill Belichick: UNC is "way ahead" of where it was a year ago, difference is "night and day"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bill Belichick: UNC is "way ahead" of where it was a year ago, difference is "night and day"
sources.description: Bill Belichick’s first season as North Carolina’s head coach did not go as well as anyone affiliated with the university would have liked, with the program finishing 4-8 in 2025.
